gaps.note: Product Guide Table 2-9 (Issue 13, 2026) prints 0.57 lb (0.258 kg). The data sheet CID213579 (2023) prints 0.366 kg (0.81 lb). Neither says what is weighed; the manifest carries the guide's figure as the later document and the one that names the bare ONT.
gaps.wanted: a weighed unit, or a document saying whether 0.366 kg includes the power adapter

gaps.note: Product Guide Table 2-10 prints maximum power (not to exceed) 7.7 W, 10G port operational. The data sheet prints power consumption below 8.6 W with no condition. The manifest carries the guide's figure because it states its condition.
gaps.wanted: a Nokia statement of which figure is current for hardware 3TN00666

gaps.note: The guide's hardware block (Figure 2-5) names an ONT SoC without a part or a clock; the data sheet and the Quick Reference Guide say nothing. Memory and flash are stated.
gaps.wanted: the SoC named in a Nokia document

gaps.note: No lamp window is drawn in the jack on Figure 2-2 and none shows in the one render held, which is three-quarter and 851 px wide. A straight-on photograph of the back would say whether the housing carries link lamps of its own.
gaps.wanted: a square-on photograph of the back edge of a real unit

gaps.note: No figure or render held shows the edge opposite the ports. Figure 2-1 and the render both look at the back.
gaps.wanted: a photograph or drawing of the front edge

gaps.note: The five side slots are sized from the back elevation; their run along the side is read by eye from an isometric figure and a three-quarter render.

bottom-layout.note: Product Guide Figure 3-1 p38, a plan of the underside with the keyhole spacing printed: 85 mm. GATE 1: outline 1769 x 1767 px, 13.10 px/mm from the 135 width, and the two keyholes then measure 84.5 mm apart against the printed 85 - three quantities agree. Four round feet 11.4 mm across, 25.3 mm in from each edge; two keyholes 7.6 x 12.9 mm, 25.3 mm in from the sides and centred 64.7 mm from the front edge, round end towards the back; a label recess 59.9 x 39.9 mm; one cross-head screw 7.2 mm across; a field of short slots across a raised plate about 94 x 97 mm. The figure has the back edge at the bottom; this view has it at the top.

chassis.note: Product Guide Table 2-9 p27: length 135 mm, width 135 mm, height 30 mm; the data sheet prints the same three. Weight 0.258 kg is the guide's figure; the data sheet prints 0.366 kg, recorded as a gap. Mount `desktop`: the guide stands it on four feet on a shelf or desk and also hangs it on a wall, by the two keyholes in its underside or on bracket kit 3FE48249AB/AC/AD; the feet-down way is the one drawn. THE HOUSING IS NOT A PLAIN BOX: its plan corners are rounded at about 16 mm (Figure 2-3: the outline is 40 px inside its own corner 62 px along the edge, at 10.76 px/mm) and below a shoulder 20 mm down the back face the lower shell curves in to a foot print about 102 mm wide (Figure 2-2). The chassis keys describe a box, so the views are the 135 x 135 x 30 envelope and the rounded outline is drawn on the top and bottom faces as a line.

colours.note: From the data sheet render, 851 x 581 px, by counting pixels: the top face is #f7f7f7 (median of 54,000 px); 1,224 px of the PON adapter are green, median #75ba2b; the top legends are a pale grey whose darkest eight percent of pixels read #b9b9b9 at this resolution, so the ink itself is darker and is taken as #9a9da1. A render, not a photograph of a unit.

dc-in-rating.note: Product Guide Table 2-2: fed 12 V DC 1 A from a wall adapter - the `input-voltage` and `current-max-a` of the dc-in jack. The guide's block diagram calls it a 12 V barrel and states no barrel size; the jack is the library's one nominal `dc-barrel`.

jack.note: The bare housing: Figure 2-2 draws no lamp window in the RJ-45, the data sheet lists only the four top lamps, and the render shows none at 851 px. The DATA lamp on the top face is the port lamp.

lamps.note: Product Guide Table 2-8 pp26-27. POWER green, green flashing while firmware downloads, red on a failed start or self test. PON green when ranged and authenticated, flashing while synchronising. ALARM red when downstream optical power is out of range or there is no frame lock. DATA green at 100M/1G (fast blink 1G, slow 100M), amber at 2.5G (yellow until Issue 12), white at 5G, blue at 10G, each flashing on activity. The lamp colours drawn are conventional hues for those words, not sampled.

power.note: Product Guide Table 2-10 p27: maximum power (not to exceed) 7.7 W with the 10G port operational, minimum 4.3 W with it idle. The data sheet prints power consumption below 8.6 W, recorded as a gap. Fed 12 V DC 1 A from a wall adapter (Table 2-2).

rear-layout.note: Product Guide Figure 2-2 p25, a square-on elevation of the back edge. GATE 1: the outline is 2628 px wide and 594 px from its top line to the bottom line of the shell (feet excluded), 4.42 against the stated 135 / 30 = 4.50, so it is orthographic to 1.7 percent. x at 19.47 px/mm from the 135 width; y as fractions of the 30 height. Centres, left to right as seen from behind: laser mark 24.0, PON 35.6, LAN 59.2, RESET 76.3, POWER 87.8, ON/OFF 100.3; the five sit on a line 12 to 14 mm down. The standard parts keep their registry sizes: the figure draws the RJ-45 opening 13.6 wide in an 18.3 x 11.9 moulded bezel and the SC opening 9.7 x 7.3 in a 13.6 x 9.9 adapter, and the SC opening is turned key-slot up as the figure draws its notch. Good to about 0.5 mm.

side-layout.note: Figure 2-2 shows five slots in each side wall edge-on, 1.26 mm tall on a 2.37 mm pitch, 3.5 to 14.3 mm down. How far they run along the side is not on any square-on figure: the isometric Figure 2-1 and the data sheet render show them running most of the length, and they are drawn from 12 to 123 mm by eye.

sources.note: Nokia ONT XS-010X-R Product Guide, 3TN-00666-AAAA-TCZZA Issue 13 (BBD Release 26.03): Table 2-1 the kits, Table 2-9 p27 the size and weight, Table 2-10 p27 power, Table 2-11 p28 the environment, Figure 2-2 p25 the back elevation, Figure 2-3 p26 the top plan, Figure 3-1 p38 the underside, Table 2-8 pp26-27 the lamps. Nokia ONT XS-010X-R data sheet CID213579 (September 2023), the vendor datasheet, for the summary figures and the one product render. All three guide figures are vector line art, read at 600 dpi.

top-layout.note: Product Guide Figure 2-3 p26, a plan of the top. GATE 1: outline 1452 x 1460 px for a 135 x 135 face, square to 0.5 percent, 10.76 px/mm. Four lamps 2.0 mm across in a column 15.4 mm in from the edge, 12.0 mm apart, 49.5 to 85.6 mm from the front edge. The figure is drawn with the back edge at the bottom (the on/off button shows 101.0 mm along it, against 100.3 on Figure 2-2); this view has the front edge at the bottom, so the figure is turned half a turn and the legends, which read from the back, are printed upside down here. The data sheet render shows the same four lamps and legends.

variants.note: Product Guide Table 2-1 pp15-18 lists 24 ordering kits 3TN00665xx, each with the provisioning number 3TN00666xx of the ONT inside it. They differ in the power adapter plug (AA US; BA-BM EU; CA-CK UK; DA AU) and, for BC and BG, a disabled SLID menu. Two rows state a difference in the body: BB is moulded in PCR material and BG has additional wall mounting holes (Figure 3-1 is captioned for every variant except BG). Thirteen rows are marked customer-specific variant with no further difference stated; those are not listed as configurations, and neither is BG, whose underside is not the one drawn. The row for kit 3TN00665CE prints provisioning number 3TN00666CA, which reads as a misprint for CE and is left out for the same reason.

wordmark.note: The data sheet render shows the vendor wordmark on the top face near the back edge, reading from the front. No line drawing shows it, and the render is a three-quarter view, so the zone reserved for it is placed by eye: centred across the face, about 11 to 17 mm from the back edge. Not drawn - a reserved logo zone.
